% 6 solution-03
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1cm,y=1cm]
  \coordinate (O) at (0,0); \draw[body,fill=orange!8] (O) circle (1.8);
  \draw[vec] (O)--(3.5,2.0) node[right] {$\bm V$};
  \draw[vec,orange] (O)--(0,3.2) node[above] {$\bm t_1$};
  \draw[vec,orange] (O)--(3.0,1.75) node[above right] {$\bm t_2$};
  \draw[guide] (0,0)--(-3,0) node[left] {$\bm n_1$};
  \draw[force] (1.4,1.1) arc (38:-36:1.2) node[right] {$\omega$ 顺时针};
  \node[align=left,anchor=west] at (-4.8,-3.1)
    {$\bm V\!\cdot\bm t_i=v_i-r\omega\equiv u_i$\\[3pt]
     $V=\dfrac{\sqrt{u_1^2+u_2^2-2u_1u_2\cos\alpha}}{\sin\alpha}$\\[3pt]
     $\omega_1=-\dfrac{\bm V\cdot\bm n_1}{l_1}$};
\end{tikzpicture}

% 14 solution-07
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1cm,y=1cm]
  \draw[body] (-5,-1.2)--(5,-1.2); \fill (-4.2,-1.2) circle (2.5pt) node[below] {固定端};
  \draw[very thick,orange] (-4.2,-1.2)--(-.2,-1.2) node[midway,above] {$A$};
  \draw[very thick,blue] (-.2,-1.2)--(3.8,-1.2) node[midway,above] {$B$};
  \fill (-.2,-1.2) circle (2.5pt) node[below] {铰点};
  \draw[force] (2.0,-1.2)--++(0,2.0) node[right] {$I$};
  \draw[dim] (2.0,-2.0)--(3.8,-2.0) node[midway,below] {$h$};
  \draw[force,green] (-.2,-.95)--++(0,1.4) node[left] {$H$};
  \node[align=left,anchor=west] at (-4.6,1.8)
    {$I+H=\dfrac32ml\omega$\\[2pt]
     $-Hl=\dfrac13ml^2\omega$\\[2pt]
     $h=\dfrac6{11}l,\quad\omega=\dfrac{6I}{11ml}$};
\end{tikzpicture}
